 succeeded in 0ms:
     1	# ADR-0006: Cross-location asymmetry-audit checklist (process rule)
     2	
     3	| 字段 | 值                                    |
     4	| ---- | ------------------------------------- |
     5	| 状态 | accepted                              |
     6	| 日期 | 2026-04-30                            |
     7	| 作者 | orchestrator (Claude Opus 4.7 1M ctx) |
     8	| 触发 | Wave 1 codex 5.5 reviews caught 12 instances of the same meta-class across 6 tracks + 5 close-ceremony fix iterations (8 distinct items + 4 close-ceremony reinforcements of items #6 and #8) |
     9	| 替代 | 不替代任何 ADR；扩展 [ADR-0001](ADR-0001-stack-selection.md) §3.2 review chain |
    10	
    11	## Context
    12	
    13	Wave 1 implementation produced strong empirical evidence that **a single bug class** dominates the failure mode at line-level review:
    14	
    15	> **Cross-location asymmetry**: a value, schema, algorithm, or invariant exists in two or more places, and an edit to one location is not symmetrically applied to all peers, so behavior diverges silently.
    16	
    17	Across 6 tracks + 5 close-ceremony fix iterations, codex 5.5 (`pr-gate`) caught **12 instances** of this meta-class (8 distinct failure-mode items + 4 close-ceremony reinforcements of items #6 and #8). Every PR that lasted ≥ 2 review rounds hit at least one instance. The pattern is so consistent that linear "fix the cited blocker, ship v_n+1" iteration would not have caught the second-order asymmetry; codex specifically catches the symmetric counterpart that the worker missed.
    18	
    19	### Wave 1 empirical record (12 instances)
    20	
    21	| # | Track | Round | Asymmetry pair | Bug behavior |
    22	|---|---|---|---|---|
    23	| 1 | Track B (block-foundation + content-types) | R1 → fixed v3 | `listUIs` mutability vs `listCores` defensive copy | Caller mutation of return value polluted registry singleton |
    24	| 2 | Track D (apps/api) | R2 → fixed v4 | RFC 7235 `WWW-Authenticate` on framework-raised 401 vs custom `SkbError` 401 | 4 of 5 401 paths emitted spec-mandated header; the custom-error path silently dropped it |
    25	| 3 | Track F (editor-commands) | R3 → fixed v4 | `.strict()` on top-level Zod object vs nested `frontmatterSchema` | Top-level rejected unknown keys; nested still silently stripped them |
    26	| 4 | Track C (mdx-bridge) | R2 → fixed v4 | `marksEqual` link comparator: `href` only vs `href + title` | Same href, different titles silently merged into one link with the first title preserved |
    27	| 5 | Track F v5 | R3 → fixed v6 | One CONTRACT.md updated to reflect code; sister CONTRACT.md (`agent-tools`) had stale wording | Documentation-vs-code drift in the file the worker did not edit |
    28	| 6 | Track A | R1 → fixed v2 | FOUC inline IIFE saved-value algorithm + content schema | Truthy-coerce diverges from strict-whitelist for invalid / case-mismatched values; inline `z.object` redefinition diverges from `frontmatterSchema` authority |
    29	| 7 | Track A v2 | R2 → fixed v3 | FOUC inline IIFE try/catch scope | Wide try/catch in IIFE swallowed `matchMedia` exceptions while authority's narrow try/catch propagated; storage-throws scenarios produced light→dark hydration flash |
    30	| 8 | Wave 1 close bundle v1 | R1 → fixed v2 | ADR-0006 mandated reviewer-prompt updates vs actual `agent-contract.md` / generated `.claude/agents/*.md` / `docs/review-checklist.md` / `team-operations.md` content | The close-ceremony commit codified a process rule that mandates downstream behavior; consumer-side artifacts (reviewer prompts + runbook) had not been updated to embed the rule, so Wave 2 reviewers would not have seen it |
    31	| 9 | Wave 1 close bundle v2 | R2 → fixed v3 | ADR-0006:81 within-document drift "7 distinct instances" | Single bullet missed during the v1→v2 count sweep — sister-bullet variant of item #6 within a single document |
    32	| 10 | Wave 1 close bundle v3 | R3 → fixed v4 | ADR-0006:117 within-document drift "7 empirical instances + 18+ erratum candidates" (both numbers stale) | Second sister-bullet drift in the same file, a different bullet — proved per-citation fixes are themselves item #6 traps; comprehensive sweep at fix time is the robust pattern |
    33	| 11 | Wave 1 close bundle v4 (informational) | R4 (informational) → fixed v5 | structure baseline:66 "× 7 endpoints" while apps/api has 4 routes / 11 tests | Pre-existing content-accuracy drift in the structure baseline document (authored at v1) — content number mismatched real code; surfaced during the broader 11th-class hunt |
    34	| 12 | Wave 1 close bundle v5 | R2 (pr-gate) → fixed v6 | Regenerated `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` + `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` + `docs/review-checklist.md` were not staged in the bundle commit — authority + generator code updated, but generator outputs remained at pre-update HEAD content | Sub-form of item #8: regenerating an artifact and `git add`'ing it are separate steps; a bundle that updates authority + generator without staging the regenerated outputs is silently stale. Motivated the "verify by clean second-run" step now part of item #8. |
    35	
    36	Codex's structured review consistently caught these with three patterns:
    37	
    38	1. After fixing one location, **codex audits all peer locations** (not just the cited site)
    39	2. After a value/schema acquires an attribute, **codex audits every comparator/serialization function** for that attribute
    40	3. After a "happy path" fix, **codex audits the exception path** for the same equivalence
    41	
    42	These three habits collectively define the process rule below.
    43	
    44	## Decision
    45	
    46	Adopt an **8-point asymmetry-audit checklist** as a mandatory part of `code-reviewer` (Codex 5.3-spark, default cheap) and `pr-gate` (Codex 5.5, deep) review prompts. Reviewers MUST work through every applicable item before declaring PASS.
    47	
    48	### The 8 items
    49	
    50	1. **Field/attribute audit**: After adding a field to a data shape (Zod schema, Pydantic model, TS interface, mdast attrs, etc.), audit every comparator / equality / serialization / canonicalization function that handles this shape. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #4 — `marksEqual` link branch missed `title` when serialize emitted it.)
    51	
    52	2. **Status code audit**: After adding a status code to one HTTP handler (or, generally, an exit/error code to one branch), audit every other handler emitting the same code. RFC-mandated headers (RFC 7235 `WWW-Authenticate` on 401, RFC 7231 `Allow` on 405) attach to **the status code itself**, not the framework code path that emitted it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #2 — custom `SkbError` 401 path missed `WWW-Authenticate`.)
    53	
    54	3. **Strictness audit**: After adding `.strict()` (Zod) / `extra='forbid'` (Pydantic) at one level of an object schema, audit every nested object/sub-schema. The strictness setting **does not propagate**; nested objects must opt in independently. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #3 — top-level `.strict()` shipped while nested `frontmatterSchema` still silently stripped unknown keys.)
    55	
    56	4. **Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package (e.g. `@skb/content-types/frontmatterSchema`), audit every consumer for inline duplicates or inline redefinitions that should `import` instead. The "deferred swap" pattern — "I'll inline now and import later" — is a contract break that compounds over time. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 2 — apps/site/content.config.ts inlined `z.object(...)` rather than importing `frontmatterSchema`.)
    57	
    58	5. **Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or runtime constant is replicated outside its authority (e.g. inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, pre-hydration boot logic that cannot import from packages), audit every consumer-side replica for byte-equivalent reproduction. The replica must register a **regression test** that asserts equivalence against the authority across a representative input corpus. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 1 — FOUC IIFE truthy-coerce vs `getInitialTheme()` strict-whitelist; remediated with `apps/site/src/__tests__/fouc-script.test.ts` 16-row corpus.)
    59	
    60	6. **Sister-file documentation audit**: After updating one CONTRACT.md (or any document that describes a code surface), audit ALL related CONTRACT.md files in the package family for sister-file drift. Two CONTRACT.md files that describe two halves of the same contract must use **identical terminology** for the shared identifiers (function names, schema names, refine predicate names). (Wave 1 evidence: instance #5 — `editor-commands/CONTRACT.md` updated to cite `editBlockInputSchema` while `agent-tools/CONTRACT.md` still referred to the old shape.)
    61	
    62	7. **Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling across files, audit BOTH the happy-path semantics AND the `try/catch` scope between authority and replica. Narrow vs wide `try/catch` can produce divergent fall-through behavior even with identical happy-path logic. Specifically: when `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `IndexedDB` / `matchMedia` / any browser API in the algorithm path can throw, the `try/catch` MUST wrap ONLY the throwing call, with the fall-through branch (matchMedia / system default / DOM apply) running AFTER the catch handler — not inside it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #7 — FOUC IIFE wide-scope try/catch swallowed matchMedia exceptions; remediated with narrow try/catch + 2 storage-throws regression tests.)
    63	
    64	8. **Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) **OR a dependency authority (`package.json`)** that mandates behavior in downstream consumers, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact for synchronized update **AND staged-in-the-git-index in the same bundle**. Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.
    65	
    66	   **Operational sequence** (do not skip steps):
    67	   ```bash
    68	   # 1. Edit authority + generator code
    69	   # 2. Run codegen
    70	   pnpm generate:configs
    71	   # 3. Stage regenerated outputs (CRITICAL — see Pitfall below)
    72	   git add <regenerated/path/foo.md> <regenerated/path/bar.md>
    73	   # 4. Verify index reflects content (NOT just working tree):
    74	   git diff --cached --stat -- <regenerated paths>
    75	   #    → expects non-empty diff with the expected line counts
    76	   # 5. Verify idempotence: re-run codegen + confirm working tree matches index:
    77	   pnpm generate:configs
    78	   git status --short -- <regenerated paths>
    79	   #    → expects column-1 'M' (staged) + column-2 blank (working tree clean)
    80	   ```
    81	
    82	   **Pitfall (this is the load-bearing step)**: `git status --short` shows two columns: column 1 is index-vs-HEAD; column 2 is working-tree-vs-index. After running the generator without `git add`, you see `' M'` (space + M) — **working tree differs from index, but index still matches HEAD**. `git commit` only commits the index. Skipping `git add` means the regenerated content is in your working tree but NOT in the next commit. The bundle would land authority + generator-code changes WITHOUT the regenerated outputs, leaving consumers (Wave 2 reviewers reading `.claude/agents/*.md`) at pre-update content. Use `git diff --cached` (not `git status`) as the canonical staging-verification command — `--cached` shows index-vs-HEAD only, which is what `git commit` will produce.
    83	
    84	   **Pitfall extension — `pnpm-lock.yaml` is a generated artifact too (sub-form C below)**: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump / `@types/*` shift), `pnpm install` regenerates `pnpm-lock.yaml` as a deterministic derived artifact. Skipping `git add pnpm-lock.yaml` produces the same class of failure as skipping `git add .claude/agents/*.md`: working tree has the synced lockfile but the **index** still holds HEAD's stale lockfile, so the bundle ships `package.json` ahead of its lockfile. CI runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from the bundled state, sees the stale lockfile disagreeing with the new `package.json`, and fails install. The same `git diff --cached --stat -- pnpm-lock.yaml` canonical verification applies. (Wave 1 erratum commit `e15ec36`; codified as sub-form C below.)
    85	
    86	   Generated-from-authority files carry their own header comment ("GENERATED FROM agent-contract.md — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND") OR YAML frontmatter declaring authority source — both forms are acceptable. `pnpm-lock.yaml` lacks an explicit header (the format is fixed by pnpm) but is implicitly declared by `pnpm install`'s contract — its authority is `package.json` + the workspace `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
    87	
    88	   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.
    89	
    90	### Wave 2 prep notes (forward-compatibility application)
    91	
    92	The 8 items have specific Wave 2 trip-hazards already identified by Wave 1's review record:
    93	
    94	- **Item #1 + Wave 2 attr-bearing marks**: when the first attr-bearing mark beyond `link` is added to mdx-bridge (e.g. `highlight: {color}`, `kbd: {style}`), the worker MUST simultaneously update `wrapMark` AND `marksEqual` AND add a fixture exercising attr-equality + attr-distinction. Default `return true` in `marksEqual` is a silent-drop trap for any attr-bearing mark. (See pr-gate Track C v4 R3 caveat.)
    95	
    96	- **Item #2 + Wave 2 new error categories**: when Wave 2+ adds new HTTP error categories (e.g. `auth-rate-limit`, `kernel-timeout`), each new `SkbError` subclass MUST emit the same RFC-mandated headers as framework-raised peers. Add a unit test asserting header presence per error type. (See `apps/api/CONVENTIONS.md` §5 Pitfall + Pitfall continued.)
    97	
    98	- **Item #5 + Wave 2 client-side replications**: when apps/site adds new client-side algorithm replications (theme variants beyond light/dark, locale negotiation pre-hydration, etc.), the worker MUST audit both saved-value semantics AND try/catch scope against authority. (See `packages/design-tokens/CONTRACT.md` Inverse-direction obligation invariant.)
    99	
   100	- **Item #7 + future inline scripts**: ANY future `<script is:inline>` block in the project that needs pre-hydration replication of a package algorithm MUST follow the FOUC template (narrow try/catch + corpus regression test).
   101	
   102	## Consequences
   103	
   104	### Positive
   105	
   106	- **Catch the failure mode proactively**: Wave 1 evidence shows reviewer-applied checklist would have caught all 12 instances on the first review round (including the close-ceremony dogfood instance #8 + the 4 fix-loop reinforcements), eliminating 12 round-trip cycles
   107	- **Reviewer prompt clarity**: code-reviewer + pr-gate codex profile prompts gain a concrete, enumerable checklist rather than the implicit "look for symmetric counterparts" expectation
   108	- **Worker self-audit**: workers gain a pre-PR checklist they can run before reporting `ready-for-review`, catching their own asymmetries (memory: `feedback_verification_fresh_state.md` showed the verification-rigor lesson; this checklist is the analogous rigor at code-design level)
   109	- **Empirical grounding**: 12 distinct instances spread across 6 tracks + 5 close-ceremony fix iterations make this rule data-driven, not a "best practice" speculation; instances #9-12 reinforce items #6 + #8 specifically through close-ceremony fix-loop evidence
   110	
   111	### Costs
   112	
   113	- **Review-round time**: applying 8-point audit at every review adds ~5-10 minutes per round of code-reviewer + pr-gate runtime. Acceptable trade-off given Wave 1 round-counts (Track F: 5 rounds; Track A: 3 rounds; Track C: 4 rounds; Track D: 4 rounds) — front-loading review thoroughness reduces total cycles
   114	- **Worker prompt overhead**: each spawn prompt now needs a reference to this ADR + the 8-point checklist. Marginal cost.
   115	- **False-positive risk**: items that don't apply (e.g. #2 "status code" doesn't apply to TS-only packages) need to be triaged and skipped. Reviewer profile prompts must explicitly say "skip items not applicable to this PR's scope" to avoid bloat.
   116	
   117	### Risks (mitigated)
   118	
   119	- **Risk**: workers might mechanically check items without thinking, producing false confidence. **Mitigation**: each item enumerates concrete failure modes from Wave 1, not abstract heuristics — easier to apply
   120	- **Risk**: this list might grow unbounded as Wave 2+ surfaces new asymmetry classes. **Mitigation**: ADR amendments are cheap; each new instance produces an ADR-0006 erratum capturing item #N+1. Wave 2 close ceremony reviews instances and adds items as needed.
   121	
   122	## Implementation
   123	
   124	### Reviewer prompt updates
   125	
   126	`code-reviewer` and `pr-gate` profile prompts MUST be updated to:
   127	
   128	1. State the 8-point checklist verbatim (or by reference to this ADR)
   129	2. Require the reviewer's verdict structure to include "asymmetry-audit applied: items {1..8} verdicts: ..."
   130	3. Explicitly mark FAIL if any applicable item is left un-audited
   131	
   132	`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md` §"角色与触发器" Tier 2 reviewer rows should cross-link to this ADR.
   133	
   134	### Worker pre-flight (template addition)
   135	
   136	Worker `ready-for-review` reports SHOULD include a brief asymmetry-audit summary: which of the 8 items applied, and the worker's self-audit verdict. Reviewers cross-check.
   137	
   138	### Wave 1 retroactive
   139	
   140	This ADR is **forward-applicable**. Wave 1 PRs that already shipped under earlier review without this checklist remain valid; the empirical instances they revealed are exactly what grounded this ADR. No retroactive re-review required.

    11	## Context
    12	
    13	Wave 1 close 后用户做了三个方向上的判断：
    14	
    15	### 观察 1：按 package 拆 agent 制造视觉八头蛇
    16	
    17	ADR-0003 D2 把每个 component block 拆 `core/` + `ui-default/`。Wave 2 即将启动 8 个 ui-default 实施。如果按 Wave 1 的 package-domain 模型派 agent（block-callout/ui-default 给 simple-block-eng，block-math/ui-default 给 render-block-eng，block-jupyter/ui-default 给 viz-block-eng…），8 个 ui-default 会被 ≥ 3 个不同 Claude agent 写，**8 种"自我品味"覆盖统一设计意图**。视觉 token 从 design-tokens 来不假，但具体 React 组件的 padding 哲学 / hover 微交互 / loading 状态等 design-tokens 不规定的部分会发散。
    18	
    19	### 观察 2：Claude usage 紧 → Codex-heavy 是必然
    20	
    21	Wave 1 数据：
    22	- Claude tokens 主要消耗：orchestrator (~30%) / 工种 worker 实施 (~40%) / pr-reviewer 每 PR (~20%) / 其他 (~10%)
    23	- Codex 5.5 在 review 阶段抓住 9/12 cross-location asymmetry（[ADR-0006](ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md) 数据）
    24	- Claude pr-reviewer 价值集中在跨文件影响 / 长上下文判断；对单包内常规变更性价比低
    25	
    26	继续按 Wave 1 模型在 Wave 2 跑 8 个 ui-default + 3 个 editor 子模块 + kernel-pyodide 实施会**把 Claude budget 消耗到下一阶段无力继续**。
    27	
    28	### 观察 3：codex 包装 agent 是纯 context 搬运
    29	
    30	Wave 1 codex agent（`code-reviewer` / `pr-gate` / `plan-challenger` / 5 个 `codex-*-eng`，共 8 个）的典型 turn：
    31	
    32	```
    33	1. 收 SendMessage（消耗 Claude turn 预算 + context window）
    34	2. 写 codex prompt（转述消息内容）
    35	3. Bash 调 codex exec --profile X < /dev/null
    36	4. 等 codex 完成
    37	5. 读 stdout 解析 PASS/FAIL
    38	6. 写 SendMessage 回 orchestrator（转述 codex 结论）
    39	```
    40	
    41	整个 turn 里 Claude wrapper **零内部状态产出**（下次激活时上下文等同于 fresh spawn），仅做 prompt 转译 + 子进程调度。在 team 模型下这是 anti-pattern：teammate 的价值在于跨 turn 累积上下文，wrapper 没有累积什么。
    42	
    43	### 三个观察的统一原理
    44	
    45	| 模型选择 | 适用条件 |
    46	|---|---|
    47	| **按 package 拆工种**（Wave 1 模型） | 包之间逻辑独立、视觉无统一意图 |
    48	| **按职能拆**（视觉 / 业务 / 流程） | 跨包需统一意图（视觉 / 安全 / 性能） |
    49	| **teammate（持续 context）** | 跨多 turn 的设计判断、跨包影响理解、长 review 累积 |
    50	| **tool（每次 stateless 调用）** | 每次调用是 fresh prompt + fresh diff，无累积价值 |
    51	
    52	Wave 2 命题：core/ 工作仍按 package（domain 工种）；ui-default/ 跨包统一意图（职能化 → ux-ui-lead）；codex 调用本质 stateless（→ tool）。
    53	
    54	## Decision
    55	
    56	### D1：新增 `ux-ui-lead` Claude teammate 作视觉单一权威
    57	
    58	**职责**：横跨 8 个 block 的 ui-default + apps/site 视觉 + editor 子模块视觉，由设计 skill 流水线驱动产出第一版 + 把令牌使用范式固化到 [`apps/api/CONVENTIONS.md`](../../apps/api/CONVENTIONS.md) 的视觉对应文档（建议新建 `packages/design-tokens/CONVENTIONS.md` 或在 design-tokens/CONTRACT.md 内补"消费方使用规范"段）。
    59	
    60	**协作模式**：
    61	- ux-ui-lead (Claude) 写第一个 ui-default 作 template（推荐 `block-callout/ui-default/`，因为 callout 是视觉最简单且通用 pattern）
    62	- `codex-block-generator`（tool，见 D5）批量仿造其他 7 个 block 的 ui-default
    63	- ux-ui-lead 审 codex 仿造产物的视觉一致性（不审 logic / schema —— 那是 mdx-doctor / domain 工种的职责）
    64	- 同 mode 用于 editor 子模块（slash-menu / drag-handle / toolbar 三选一作 template，余两个 codex-clone）
    65	
    66	**spawn prompt 注入**（ADR-0007 D4 详述）：
    67	- `team-operations.md` 全文（按 ADR-0004 D6 强制）
    68	- 三个设计 skill 链
    69	- ADR-0003 全文（headless / UI 分层）
    70	- design-tokens 当前 CSS var + Tailwind preset 内容
    71	
    72	**能力边界**：
    73	- 写 React 组件 + Tailwind class + a11y 属性 + 视觉测试
    74	- **不**改 BlockCoreDefinition / propsSchema / MDX serialize（那些是 core 层）
    75	- **不**调 codex（dispatch 给 codex-block-generator tool，由 orchestrator 执行）
    76	
    77	### D2：Claude pr-reviewer 改为选择性触发
    78	
    79	**默认 review chain**（普通 PR）：
    80	
    81	```
    82	worker → orchestrator
    83	       → [Bash] codex exec --profile code-reviewer < diff > result.txt
    84	       → orchestrator scan result.txt + diff（轻量 final 判断，相当于 lite Claude review）
    85	       → git-operator commit
    86	```
    87	
    88	**高风险 PR**（任一触发条件命中）追加 review：
    89	
    90	| 触发条件 | 追加 review |
    91	|---|---|
    92	| 修改任何 `*/CONTRACT.md`（接口形状变化，非补充） | + codex 5.5 pr-gate + Claude pr-reviewer |
    93	| 新增 / 删除 package | + codex 5.5 pr-gate + Claude pr-reviewer |
    94	| 修改 spec / agent-contract.md / 任何 ADR | + Claude pr-reviewer（不必 pr-gate，spec 类是文档） |
    95	| 触发新 ADR 创建 | + codex 5.5 pr-gate + Claude pr-reviewer |
    96	| 删除 / 重命名 package | + Claude pr-reviewer |
    97	| 跨 ≥ 3 个 package 的 PR | + Claude pr-reviewer |
    98	| performance-auditor 标记的 PR | + Claude pr-reviewer |
    99	| 修改 CI workflow / deploy / auth / security | + codex 5.5 pr-gate + Claude pr-reviewer |
   100	
   101	普通 PR（不触发任一条件）**全程无 Claude review**，由 orchestrator scan codex 5.3-spark 输出 + diff 自己做最终判断（"orchestrator 自己是 Claude，看输出做轻量判断不增 Claude turn 数"）。
   102	
   103	### D3：worker 端 template + codex-clone 模式
   104	
   105	**ui-default**（D1 已述）：ux-ui-lead 写 template 1 个 + codex-block-generator clone 7 个
   106	
   107	**core**（试点）：8 个 block-* core 模板化程度很高（propsSchema + mdxComponent name + 序列化结构），先在 simple block 集群试点：
   108	- `block-callout/core/` 由 simple-block-eng (Claude) 写作 template
   109	- `block-code/core/` + `block-image/core/` 由 codex-block-generator clone
   110	- `block-math/core/` + `block-pdf/core/` 因复杂度不同（math 含 KaTeX 决策；pdf 含 PDF.js worker）由 render-block-eng (Claude) 各自 hand-craft，**不试点**
   111	- `block-jupyter/core/` + `block-nn-viz/core/` + `block-agent-flow/core/` 复杂度高 + kernel session / canvas / DAG 各自专属，由 viz-block-eng (Claude) hand-craft，**不试点**
   112	
   113	试点效果用 Wave 2 close 时的 ADR-0003-style 错误率衡量：codex-cloned core 的 review reject rate vs hand-crafted。如果 reject rate 接近 → Wave 3 推广；高 → 退回 hand-craft。
   114	
   115	**editor 子模块**：editor-eng (Claude) 写 1 个 template（推荐 toolbar，最简单），codex-block-generator clone slash-menu + drag-handle。
   116	
   117	**测试脚手架**：所有 vitest 套件骨架统一交 codex-test-scaffolder（保持 Wave 1 决策）。
   118	
   119	### D4：design skill 流水线注入 ux-ui-lead
   120	
   121	ux-ui-lead 在 spawn 时 prompt 注入**全部三个 skill 内容**：
   122	
   123	1. **`frontend-design`**（superpowers 内置）—— 生成第一版视觉提案
   124	2. **`ui-ux-pro-max-skill`**（用户已装在 `.claude/skills/`）—— 强化设计系统 / 配色 / 行业规则
   125	3. **`web-design-guidelines`**（用户已装；Vercel 风格审）—— 终审
   126	
   127	**为什么三个一起注入而非按 task 分阶段**：
   128	- Wave 2 多个 block 共用一份视觉契约；分阶段注入意味着每个 block 串 3 段，整体串行 24 段（8 block × 3 段），太长
   129	- 一次性全注入让 ux-ui-lead 能在写 template 阶段就**预先**应用三段约束，少返工
   130	- 串接顺序仍保留：lead 写 template 时心中先 frontend-design → 再 ui-ux-pro-max → 再 vercel-review，这是它**内部**思考顺序，不是 spawn 阶段
   131	
   132	**约束**：三个 skill 加起来 spawn prompt 体积膨胀。监控点：ux-ui-lead 第一次 spawn 时 token 消耗对比 Wave 1 worker 平均值；如超过 2× 重新评估是否分阶段。
   133	
   134	### D5：codex agents 降级为 orchestrator-direct tools
   135	
   136	**变更**：8 个 codex 角色（`code-reviewer` / `pr-gate` / `plan-challenger` / `codex-block-generator` / `codex-test-scaffolder` / `codex-script-builder` / `codex-api-crud-builder` / `codex-css-stylist`）从 team teammate 模型移除，改为 orchestrator + 工种 lead 通过 Bash 直接调 `codex exec --profile X < /dev/null` 的 **invocation pattern**（不是 agent，不在 team config，不消耗 Claude teammate 槽位）。
   137	
   138	**新的 agent 阵容（共 20 teammate + 8 tool pattern = 28 项配置实体；T0:1 + T1:11 + T2:4 + T3:4，T3 audit 按需复用）**：
   139	
   140	```
   141	TIER 0: Orchestrator (Claude, 1)
   142	
   143	TIER 1: Worker Teammates (Claude, 11)
   144	  block-foundation-eng / simple-block-eng / render-block-eng /
   145	  viz-block-eng / mdx-bridge-eng / kernel-architect / kernel-pyodide-eng /
   146	  editor-eng / editor-integrator / ux-ui-lead (新, ADR-0007 D1) / api-builder
   147	
   148	TIER 2: Process Teammates (Claude, 4)
   149	  pr-reviewer (选择性触发, ADR-0007 D2) / git-operator / refactorer / researcher
   150	
   151	TIER 3: Audit Teammates (Claude, ?)  ── Wave 1 是 4，Wave 2 起根据需要复用
   152	  structure-auditor / performance-auditor / mdx-doctor / link-checker
   153	
   154	────────────────────────────────────────
   155	
   156	TOOL: Codex Invocation Patterns (8)
   157	  code-reviewer       → codex exec --profile code-reviewer < /dev/null
   158	  pr-gate             → codex exec --profile pr-gate < /dev/null
   159	  plan-challenger     → codex exec --profile plan-challenger < /dev/null
   160	  codex-block-generator → codex exec --profile scaffolder ...
   161	  codex-test-scaffolder → same
   162	  codex-script-builder  → same
   163	  codex-api-crud-builder → same
   164	  codex-css-stylist     → same
   165	```
   166	
   167	**操作变化**：
   168	- review 链每 PR 节省 ~2-3 个 Claude wrapper turn
   169	- 8 teammate spawn 成本省了
   170	- agent-contract.md 拆 `agents:`（teammate）+ `tool_patterns:`（codex）两段
   171	- 新 runbook `docs/runbooks/codex-tool-invocations.md`（生成产物）描述每个 pattern 的 canonical Bash 调用 + 触发条件 + 错误处理
   172	
   173	### 组合效果（D1-D5 联动）
   174	
   175	Wave 2 一个典型常规 PR（block-X/ui-default 仿造）的 turn 序列：
   176	
   177	```
   178	1. orchestrator: SendMessage codex-block-generator (← tool, 不是 teammate)
   179	   实际：orchestrator 直接 Bash: codex exec --profile scaffolder < prompt.txt > out.txt
   180	2. orchestrator 读 out.txt + git diff 自检
   181	3. ux-ui-lead 收消息 review 视觉一致性 (Claude turn, 不可省)
   182	4. orchestrator: Bash: codex exec --profile code-reviewer < diff > review.txt
   183	5. orchestrator scan review.txt: PASS
   184	6. 是否高风险？普通 ui-default clone：否
   185	7. orchestrator: SendMessage git-operator commit (Claude turn)
   186	8. git-operator commit + push (Claude turn)
   187	9. CI 验证
   188	```
   189	
   190	Wave 1 同等 PR 需要 ~7 Claude teammate turn（worker spawn / code-reviewer turn / pr-gate turn / pr-reviewer turn / git-operator turn / + orchestrator coordinating）。Wave 2 降到 **~3 Claude turn**（ux-ui-lead 视觉 review / orchestrator coordinating + final scan / git-operator）。**节省 ~50-60% Claude tokens / PR**。
   191	
   192	## Consequences
   193	
   194	### 正面
   195	
   196	- **视觉单一权威**：ui-default 跨 8 block + apps/site + editor 子模块由 ux-ui-lead 一手把关
   197	- **Claude budget 压力解除**：估计 Wave 2 全程 Claude tokens 降 ~40-50%（Codex 反向上升，但 5.3-spark + 5.5 总成本远低于 Claude）
   198	- **review chain 更精准**：高风险 PR 仍保留 Claude pr-reviewer 长上下文判断；常规 PR 不浪费
   199	- **codex tool 调用更直接**：8 个 wrapper turn / PR 消除
   200	- **agent-contract.md 拆 agents/tools 让 schema 更准**：Claude teammate 是有 context 的，codex tool 是 stateless invocation —— schema 区分更准确
   201	
   202	### 负面 / 待应对
   203	
   204	- **agent-contract.md restructure 是 high-risk PR**（触碰 authority + 全部 generated outputs），必须严格走 ADR-0006 D8 staging protocol
   205	- **template + codex-clone 试点风险**：core 层试点（D3 §"core (试点)"）若 reject rate 高，Wave 2 plan 中段可能需要回退；规避：试点限定在 simple block，复杂 block 不参与试点
   206	- **三 skill 一次注入 prompt 体积**（D4）：监控 ux-ui-lead 第一 spawn 的 token 消耗
   207	- **orchestrator 内联 codex 调用增加 orchestrator turn 复杂度**：原 turn 内只做调度，现在还要 scan codex 输出做轻判；评估方式：Wave 2 几个 PR 后看 orchestrator turn 平均长度
   208	- **失去 teammate-level audit 跟踪**：原 codex teammate 至少有 inbox 历史；现在 tool invocation 仅留 Bash 命令历史。**对应措施**：所有 codex tool 调用 stdout/stderr 必须保存到 `docs/audits/codex-runs/<date>-<task>.txt`（自动）作 audit 兜底
   209	- **plan-challenger 现在是 tool**：原本就是 one-shot 调用，现在去掉 wrapper 反而是清理；ADR-0004 D7 一直把它说成"一次性 dispatch"，与 tool 模型一致
   210	
   211	### 影响其他 ADR / spec
   212	
   213	| 文档 | 改动 |
   214	|---|---|
   215	| spec §3.1（27 agent → 20 teammate + 8 tool） | 改 §3.1 节标题与 diagram；agent 列表加 ux-ui-lead；codex 8 个移到新"Tool patterns"段 |
   216	| spec §3.2（review 工作流） | 改为：默认 codex 5.3-spark + orchestrator 自检；高风险条件触发 pr-gate / Claude pr-reviewer |
   217	| ADR-0001 §3.1 / §3.2（review 模型） | ADR-0007 显式扩展，不替代；ADR-0001 仍是基础架构源 |
   218	| ADR-0003 D2-D6 | ux-ui-lead 是 D2 / D3 落地的执行者；不破坏 ADR-0003 决策 |
   219	| ADR-0004 D2 / D5 / D7 | D2 spawn 模型 + D5 全 codex 是 teammate 的旧约定 + D7 一次性 Task —— ADR-0007 D5 是其延伸（tool 是 Task 一次性的进一步抽象）；不破坏 |
   220	| ADR-0006 8-point checklist | 不破坏；本 ADR 实施时**就是** ADR-0006 D8 的考验场（authority + generator + outputs 必须同 bundle staged） |
   221	
   222	## Wave 2 Pre-Task 0 实施指南（高风险，须走完整 review chain）
   223	
   224	本 ADR 是决策记录；实际实施作为 **Wave 2 Pre-Task 0** 在 team 流程中执行。**实施步骤序列**（必须严格按此顺序，并满足 ADR-0006 D8 staging protocol）：
   225

     1	# Review checklist
     2	
     3	> **GENERATED FROM agent-contract.md — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.**
     4	>
     5	> Edit `agent-contract.md` then run `pnpm generate:configs`.
     6	
     7	This is the shared rubric for the review chain. Each section maps to one reviewer agent.
     8	
     9	## Common invariants (every reviewer must verify)
    10	
    11	- [ ] **No worker-side `git` mutating commands.** PRs containing `git commit` / `git push` / `git rebase` outside `git-operator` dispatches are rejected.
    12	- [ ] **No worker-side `web_search` / `web_fetch`.** External web access must be sourced via researcher dispatch.
    13	- [ ] **No cross-package moves outside `refactorer`.** Moves under `packages/*` or `apps/*` boundaries require an ADR + refactorer dispatch.
    14	- [ ] **File size**: warn at 300 (ESLint), hard fail at 500 (`pnpm size-check`).
    15	- [ ] **Cross-references**: all internal markdown links resolve (`pnpm link-check`).
    16	- [ ] **Contracts in sync**: `packages/*/CONTRACT.md`, `agent-contract.md`, and code interfaces match.
    17	
    18	Spec: §3.1 + §3.2 + §3.6 + §3.5.
    19	
    20	## ADR-0006 asymmetry-audit checklist (mandatory for code-reviewer + pr-gate)
    21	
    22	Apply each item that is in scope for the PR; explicitly skip items that are not (e.g. item #2 "status code" doesn't apply to TS-only packages). Reviewer verdict structure MUST include `asymmetry-audit applied: items {1..8} verdicts: ...`. See [ADR-0006](decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md) for empirical evidence + full rationale per item.
    23	
    24	- [ ] **#1 Field/attribute audit**: After adding a field to a data shape, audit every comparator/equality/serialization function for that field.
    25	- [ ] **#2 Status code audit**: After adding a status code to one handler, audit every other handler emitting the same code; RFC-mandated headers (RFC 7235 `WWW-Authenticate`, RFC 7231 `Allow`) attach to the status code itself.
    26	- [ ] **#3 Strictness audit**: After adding `.strict()` / `extra='forbid'` at one level, audit every nested object/sub-schema (strictness does not propagate).
    27	- [ ] **#4 Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package, audit every consumer for inline duplicates; "deferred swap" is a contract break.
    28	- [ ] **#5 Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or constant is replicated outside its authority (inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, etc.), audit consumer-side replicas for byte-equivalent reproduction; replica MUST register a regression test against the authority's input corpus.
    29	- [ ] **#6 Sister-file documentation audit**: After updating one CONTRACT.md (or analogous document), audit ALL related CONTRACT.md files for sister-file drift; shared identifiers must use identical terminology across both halves of the contract.
    30	- [ ] **#7 Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling, audit BOTH happy-path semantics AND `try/catch` scope between authority and replica; narrow vs wide try/catch can produce divergent fall-through behavior.
    31	- [ ] **#8 Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) that mandates downstream behavior, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact in the same commit; regenerate codegen outputs (`pnpm generate:configs`); cross-link runbooks; embed in subagent prompts.
    32	
    33	`pr-gate` MUST additionally hunt for an 8th-class instance beyond the cited fix (Wave 1 evidence: pr-gate caught one extra asymmetry per round on every Wave 1 high-risk PR).
    34	
    35	## For code-reviewer (Codex 5.3-spark)
    36	
    37	Default cheap line-level review. Output PASS / FAIL with concrete issues.
    38	
    39	- [ ] **Types**: no `any` leakage; `unknown` narrowed at boundaries; `pnpm exec tsc -b` clean.
    40	- [ ] **Lint**: `pnpm exec eslint .` produces no errors (warnings tolerated).
    41	- [ ] **File size**: every changed file under 500 lines; aim for 200, warn at 300.
    42	- [ ] **Contracts**: any change to `packages/*/CONTRACT.md` matches the implementation
    43	      in the same PR (no orphan interface drift).
    44	- [ ] **Module boundaries**: imports respect package boundaries (no reaching into another
    45	      package's `src/internal/`); no circular deps introduced.
    46	- [ ] **Style**: prettier-clean; no commented-out blocks; no leftover `console.log`.
    47	
    48	## For pr-gate (Codex 5.5, high-risk only)
    49	
    50	Triggered by: contract change, package add/remove, core arch touch, ADR-required PR,
    51	CI/deploy/auth/security touch. Deep scan.
    52	
    53	- [ ] **Vulnerabilities**: no obvious injection / XSS / SSRF / deserialization sinks; secrets
    54	      never read from request bodies; HTTP responses don't leak internal state.
    55	- [ ] **Cross-package side effects**: changes to one package don't silently break another
    56	      (especially `block-foundation`, `mdx-bridge`, `kernel-adapter` consumers).
    57	- [ ] **Supply chain**: any new dependency vetted for maintenance status, license, and
    58	      transitive risk; no abandoned forks.
    59	- [ ] **Lockfile integrity**: `pnpm-lock.yaml` change is consistent with `package.json`
    60	      diffs; no unexplained version churn; no peer-dep warnings worsened.
    61	- [ ] **Auth / boundary**: no permission expanded silently (e.g. router exposing previously
    62	      private route); CSRF / SameSite still enforced; no `eval` / `Function` constructor.
    63	
    64	## For pr-reviewer (Claude)
    65	
    66	Implementation quality, regression risk, spec match. Output APPROVE / REJECT + reasoning.
    67	
    68	- [ ] **Spec compliance**: implementation matches the locked design spec (cite section).
    69	- [ ] **Regression risk**: existing tests still cover the affected paths; no behavior change
    70	      that would break a downstream package or doc snippet.
    71	- [ ] **Architectural consistency**: change matches existing patterns; new patterns have an
    72	      ADR under `docs/decisions/` if cross-cutting.
    73	- [ ] **Cross-file impact**: every doc / cross-reference updated (`agent-contract.md` →
    74	      regenerate; `CONTRACT.md` ↔ implementation; `docs/plans/` reflects status).
    75	- [ ] **Tests**: `vitest` / `pytest` coverage for new behavior; no flaky timing-dependent
    76	      assertions.

     4	 * BaseLayout.astro ships an inline `<script>` that runs before any module

    27	function extractFoucIife(src: string): string {
    28	  const startMarker = '(function () {';
    29	  const endMarker = '})();';
    30	  const startIdx = src.indexOf(startMarker);
    31	  const endIdx = src.indexOf(endMarker, startIdx);
    32	  if (startIdx < 0 || endIdx < 0) {
    33	    throw new Error('Could not locate FOUC IIFE in BaseLayout.astro');
    34	  }
    35	  return src.slice(startIdx, endIdx + endMarker.length);
    36	}

   100	function runGetInitialThemeWith(
   101	  storage: FakeStorage,
   102	  matchMedia: FakeMatchMedia,
   103	): 'dark' | 'light' {
   104	  const originalLocalStorage = window.localStorage;
   105	  const originalMatchMedia = window.matchMedia;
   106	  // happy-dom's window properties are configurable; swap them for the call.
   107	  Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', { configurable: true, value: storage });
   108	  // @ts-expect-error overriding for the controlled call
   109	  window.matchMedia = matchMedia;
   110	  try {
   111	    return getInitialTheme();
   112	  } finally {
   113	    Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {
   114	      configurable: true,
   115	      value: originalLocalStorage,
   116	    });
   117	    window.matchMedia = originalMatchMedia;
   118	  }
   119	}

     6	/**
     7	 * localStorage key — kept literally in sync with the inline FOUC script in

     9	 * cross-package contract break.

    11	export const STORAGE_KEY = 'skb-theme';
    12	
    13	export function getInitialTheme(): ThemeName {
    14	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'light';
    15	  try {
    16	    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    17	    if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') return saved;
    18	  } catch {
    19	    /* localStorage unavailable; fall through to system preference */
    20	  }
    21	  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
    22	}
    23	
    24	/**
    25	 * DOM-only theme application. Idempotent and safe to call on every mount /
    26	 * effect — does NOT touch localStorage. Persistence is intentionally split out
    27	 * so first-mount system-preference reads don't clobber future OS theme
    28	 * changes (ADR-0003 D6: localStorage write is coupled to manual user action).
    29	 */
    30	export function applyThemeDOM(theme: ThemeName): void {
    31	  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    32	  if (theme === 'dark') {
    33	    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    34	  } else {
    35	    document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    36	  }
    37	}
    38	
    39	function persistTheme(theme: ThemeName): void {
    40	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    41	  try {
    42	    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, theme);
    43	  } catch {
    44	    /* swallow: localStorage unavailable (quota / private mode) */
    45	  }
    46	}

    54	export function useTheme(): UseThemeResult {
    55	  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<ThemeName>(getInitialTheme);
    56	
    57	  useEffect(() => {
    58	    applyThemeDOM(theme);
    59	  }, [theme]);
    60	
    61	  const setTheme = useCallback((t: ThemeName) => {
    62	    persistTheme(t);
    63	    setThemeState(t);
    64	  }, []);
    65	
    66	  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    67	    setThemeState((current) => {
    68	      const next: ThemeName = current === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    69	      persistTheme(next);
    70	      return next;
    71	    });
    72	  }, []);
    73	
    74	  return { theme, setTheme, toggle };
    75	}

Playwright waits for actionability, not event listener attachment, so slow CI can swallow the click and time out at line 16. Add an explicit hydration wait before clicking.

This is consistent with the Wave 2 plan, but it means the smoke test validates dev-server behavior, not the built `dist/` artifact.
